description.p: Bunx2 is a personal, experimental fork of the Lichii emulator. Its main development target is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Nintendo Switch 2, on Arch Linux with NVIDIA Vulkan drivers.
It builds on Lichii, Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, and keeps their contributors' copyright notices. Compatibility and performance vary by game and hardware.
